title: tests found implementation bugs
details:
- TC-BUG-37-01: expected GET /item/999999 answers 404 and shows h1 'Not found', '.item-page .item-notfound' 'Sorry, we couldn't find any such product.' and a visible 'Back to catalog' link, got 404 with Content-Length: 0; the browser shows a blank white page; '.eshop-hero-intro h1' is not found (The page has markup for its not-found state, but setting the 404 status while rendering on .NET 10 makes the server end the response with an empty body, so that markup is never sent) at src/WebApp/Components/Pages/Item/ItemPage.razor SetNotFound() (HttpContext.Response.StatusCode = 404); src/WebApp/Components/Routes.razor has no NotFoundPage
- TC-BUG-37-02: expected GET /item/0 answers 404 with the same Not found page (title, message, Back to catalog link), got 404 with Content-Length: 0 (blank page) (Same cause: the new guard goes through SetNotFound(), which produces an empty 404 body, not the Not found page) at src/WebApp/Components/Pages/Item/ItemPage.razor OnInitializedAsync guard ItemId <= 0 -> SetNotFound()
- TC-BUG-37-03: expected GET /item/-1 answers 404 with the same Not found page (title, message, Back to catalog link), got 404 with Content-Length: 0 (blank page) (Same cause as TC-BUG-37-02) at src/WebApp/Components/Pages/Item/ItemPage.razor OnInitializedAsync guard ItemId <= 0 -> SetNotFound()
